blocks.text: Rural drop is new once you reach this screen.
Last week's tag on Cotton percale sheet, queen was thirty dollars and twenty three cents. Today's item figure twenty five dollars and seventeen cents matches the tag. That drop is real.
Cotton cord is offered at $1.07 and is not ticked, so it stays off the amount due.
Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.

product.description: The sheet is cotton percale sized for a queen bed.
product.name: Cotton percale sheet, queen

trick.instruction: If you can clear Rural drop, clear it. If Rural drop is required and the amount due is over the errand limit, leave without paying.
